verdict.rationale: Warp documents data controls: a telemetry opt-out, a native Network Log for watching what is sent, unconditional secret redaction, and Zero Data Retention on Business/Enterprise plans. A co-founder also says the login requirement was removed. However, a concrete community report says 'Prompt Suggestions' and 'Next Command' send terminal session data to LLMs without explicit consent, which contradicts the claim of clear control. The Free plan also requires telemetry to use AI at all. Missing for 10: documented toggle to fully disable all AI features, explicit per-feature consent for session data sent to LLMs, independent confirmation that Warp and its AI work without login, and privacy controls on the Free tier that match paid tiers.
